intent: Admit one cross-track security seam in the dharmagraph-owned Orchestrator: a task carrying typed SADHANA campaign authority must select exactly the nested authenticated AgentState ID or return no dispatch, while tasks without that authority retain the existing generic routing behavior.

commit.message: governance: admit exact campaign principal selection

interface_mismatches: The generic Orchestrator treats preferred names and roles as hints, then falls back to another idle agent; campaign authority requires the exact nested authenticated principal ID.
A busy or absent authenticated principal must yield no dispatch before _assign_dispatch and provider execution even when another idle agent is available.
The seam must be conditional on the typed campaign authority key so all unbound generic tasks preserve existing routing behavior.
honest_blockers: This admission changes no Orchestrator code, dispatches no task, assigns no agent, and calls no model provider.
Exact selection proves only which idle AgentState ID was handed to the owner pipeline; it does not prove future liveness, model output, acceptance, promotion, or merge.
The sibling organism packet owns manifest validation, lease issuance, task metadata, and dispatcher postconditions; this packet owns only the Orchestrator selection seam and focused proof.
No broad dharmagraph ownership is transferred; generic routing behavior without campaign authority is a mandatory regression oracle.
CLAUDE.md and SOVEREIGN_MANIFEST.md are deterministic mirrors of ACTIVE_TRACK and confer no independent authority.
session_entry.rollback: Revert this bounded admission and its deterministic generated mirrors. No task, agent, provider, execution lease, campaign process, transport, acceptance, merge, deployment, or external state is changed by admission rollback.
